    'AcceptedCmp1': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'AcceptedCmp2': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'Complain': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'Z_CostContact': [3, 3, 3, 3, 3],
    'Z_Revenue': [11, 11, 11, 11, 11],
    'Response': [1, 0, 0, 0, 0]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert date column to datetime
df['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')

# Calculate age from Year_Birth
current_year = datetime.now().year
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']

# Calculate total spending
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 
                 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
df['Total_Spending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)

# Calculate total purchases
purchase_cols = ['NumDealsPurchases', 'NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Income distribution by marital status

axes[0, 0].set_title('Income Distribution by Marital Status')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Marital Status')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Income')

# 2. Total spending by education level
sns.barplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Total_Spending', ax=axes[0, 1])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Total Spending by Education Level')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Education')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Spending')

# 3. Age vs Total Spending scatter plot
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Age', y='Total_Spending', hue='Marital_Status', 
                size='Income', sizes=(50, 300), ax=axes[0, 2])
axes[0, 2].set_title('Age vs Total Spending')
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Age')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Total Spending')

# 4. Spending composition (stacked bar)
spending_data = df[['ID'] + spending_cols].set_index('ID')
spending_data.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[1, 0])
axes[1, 0].set_title('Spending Composition by Customer')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Customer ID')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Amount Spent')
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Product Category', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# 5. Purchase channels comparison
purchase_data = df[['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']].mean()
axes[1, 1].pie(purchase_data.values, labels=purchase_data.index, autopct='%1.1f%%')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Purchases by Channel')

# 6. Customer metrics heatmap
metrics_df = df[['Income', 'Total_Spending', 'Total_Purchases', 'Recency', 'NumWebVisitsMonth']]
corr_matrix = metrics_df.corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0, ax=axes[1, 2])
axes[1, 2].set_title('Customer Metrics Correlation Heatmap')

plt.suptitle('Customer Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
